newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amplats to make three major announcements.
newsitem.headline: Amplats to make three major announcements.

text.p: Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd (Amplats) is due to make three major announcements at a press conference on Tuesday, the company said.
Amplats gave no details of the announcements.
But platinum analysts speculated that among the announcements could be the purchase of Northam Platinum Ltd from Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd or a rebundling of Amplats' platinum mines.
Other possibilities were an announcement on the disposal of Amplats' diamond interests and a possible expansion of Potgietersrust Platinums Ltd.
"I would say, Northam, the selling of the diamond interests and the PPRust expansion," BOE Natwest analyst Paul Brogan said.
